999008199.text:
ヤドヴィガ！　こんなにたくさんの魚……
いったいどうしたんだい？

localizations.en: Jadwiga! Look at all these fish... Where did they come from?

999008199.text: あれ、誰かヤドヴィガに命令したの？

localizations.en: Hm? Did someone tell you to do that?

999008199.text:
否……私の独断。
みんなに、喜んでもらえるかと思って

localizations.en: No... it was my own decision. I thought it might... make everyone happy.

999008199.text: え！？　あのヤドヴィガが自分で！？

localizations.en: Wait, seriously? You did this on your own?!

999008199.text:
そうかいそうかい……それは粋だねぇ！
ありがとう、今夜はこれでごちそうだ！

localizations.en: Well, well... now that's what I call style! Thank you, Jadwiga. Tonight, we feast!

999008199.text: やったわ！　ふふ、休暇って最高ね！

localizations.en: Yes! Hehe, vacations really are the best!

999008199.text:
ヤド姉、これ全部一人で釣ったの……？
兄弟全員分だからかな、ほんとにすごい量……

localizations.en: Jadwiga, you caught all of this by yourself...? There's so much... Is it because you were thinking of all of us?

999008199.text:
キューンには肉と果物も用意した。
骨がある魚は得意ではなかったと思って

localizations.en: I also prepared meat and fruit for you. I did not think you were fond of fish with bones.

999008199.text: えっ！　ヤド姉、ありがとう……！！

localizations.en: You did?! Thank you so much...!!

999008199.text:
ちょっと。キューンが末っ子だからって
甘やかしすぎないでよね

localizations.en: Hey now. Just because she's the youngest doesn't mean you should be spoiling her like this.

999008199.text:
ヤドヴィガの成長になると思って、
アルビーたちに同行させたけれど――

localizations.en: I sent Jadwiga along with Alvina and the others thinking it would be good for her growth, but...

999008199.text:
まさか、こんなにも影響があるとはね。
はは、いい誤算だったよ

localizations.en: I never expected it to have this much of an impact. Ha, a happy miscalculation, that.

999008199.text: ヤドヴィガ、アルビーたちとは仲良くなれたかい？

localizations.en: So, Jadwiga—did you manage to get along with Alvina and the others?

999008199.text:
あの子らは明日もまだいるんだろう？
もっと一緒に遊んでみるといいさ

localizations.en: They'll still be around tomorrow, won't they? Go spend some more time with them.

999008199.text:
ヴァレリアの兄姉で、９人兄弟の４番目。
飄々とした性格で、要領よく立ち回る

localizations.en: The fourth of nine siblings, and Valeria's elder. Easygoing and surprisingly resourceful.
